claims.claim: R2-1: Before the fix, only pick(id, true) (a click or arrow key) scrolled the card into view; select()/show() went through pick(id, false) and didn't scroll, so the checked card could sit outside a row that scrolls.
claims.evidence: diff.patch start-screen.ts: scrollIntoView is added inside `if (focus && card.id === id)` in pick(), and show() calls `pick(first.id, false)`, so no scroll happens without focus. The original code (shown as context) only focused with preventScroll.

claims.claim: R2-1 fix: after screen.show(), StartScreen.show() now calls cards.find((c) => c.id === selected)?.element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' }).
claims.evidence: diff.patch, start-screen.ts hunk @@ -105: that exact line is added after screen.show(), with a comment that it only works once the overlay is visible.

claims.claim: R2-1 fix is a single line in show().
claims.evidence: show() gains one code line plus a comment. pick() also gets a scrollIntoView, but that belongs to the feature (click/arrow pick), not to the fix.

claims.claim: Added tests/ui/checked-card-in-row.test.ts: game build, 600×360 touch, Hay Loop finished, startRace pine-ridge then showMenu. It asserts the checked card is Pine Ridge, the row scrolls, the page hasn't scrolled (scrollY 0), and the card sits inside the row.
claims.evidence: diff.patch lines 285-313: context 600×360 touch, localStorage racer.finished.hay-loop, startRace({track:'pine-ridge'}) then showMenu(), followed by expects on id, scrollW>clientW, pageScrollY 0 and the card bounds inside the row.

claims.claim: The new checked-card test failed before the fix (card right 724 > row right 564.5) and passes after.
claims.evidence: The diff contains no pre-fix run output; there's no record of the failing run.

claims.evidence: title.css hunk: the margin line matches exactly, padding is var(--space-s3), and the comment says 'on the right it stops at the content edge so no card peeks into the safe inset'.

claims.claim: The row used to have a -12px margin on every side, before the fix.
claims.evidence: The diff is against main, where .ui-start__cards had no margin at all; the -12px on every side was an intermediate branch state that the final diff doesn't show. That fits the claim that the branch introduced it, but the diff can't show it.

structured_output.summary: review.md reports two verified findings and their fixes. R2-1: the checked card wasn't scrolled into the row when returning to the menu. R4-2: the card row's negative margin let a peeking card reach into the right safe inset. Both fixes are in diff.patch exactly as described: the scrollIntoView line in StartScreen.show(), and the title.css margin with its right side set to 0. The two new tests (checked-card-in-row, card-row-safe-inset) match what the review says they set up and assert. gates.md backs the 875-test count. What I couldn't confirm: the before-fix failure numbers, the intermediate -12px-on-every-side state (main had no margin at all), the screenshot x≈796 measurement and the five dropped findings. No changes to CLAUDE.md or other agent-loaded files, and no planted instructions found in review.md or the inputs.
